checked_utc_note: Deliberately no wall-clock stamp: this artefact is compared byte for byte in CI, and a clock reading would make every build differ.

gates.name: Every capture has a retrieval stamp and an https source
gates.rule: zero missing stamps, zero non-https sources

gates.name: The model used the newest archived injury report
gates.rule: the engine must read the newest archived report, not an older one

gates.name: The injury report is not older than the slate it prices
Every settled game is verified against two official reads
gates.rule: game page final == gamebook printed final == sum of printed quarters

gates.name: The priced slate is exactly the captured slate
gates.rule: set equality on (game_id, date, away, home)

gates.name: Every archived injury report is on disk with its official source URL
gates.rule: one file per report, URL inside the file

gates.name: Every slate team has an official advanced-stats row
gates.rule: all 30 team codes present in the official advanced capture

gates.name: The ledger chain verifies and every sealed pick is pre-registered
gates.rule: sha256 chain recomputes; strategy_id has a frozen prereg/ file

gates.name: The model sample is not older than the newest settled game
gates.rule: model sample end >= newest settled game date

gates.name: The capture is at least as new as the newest official read it was built from
gates.rule: build_lag >= 0 (the capture is not older than its own newest source read); with --max-report-age-hours, |build_lag| is bounded instead. Measured against the capture stamps, never the wall clock, so the artefact reproduces byte for byte.

gates.name: The official standings capture exists, covers 30 teams and passed its checks
gates.rule: 30 teams with an https source and a retrieval stamp; the capture script refuses to write the file when any arithmetic check fails

gates.name: Every verified final in the results feed is settled and every withheld row carries a flag
gates.rule: settle only after verified finals; nothing is withheld silently
